name: Matrixdock Silver
oneLiner: XAGm is Matrixdock's silver-backed commodity token, with each token representing roughly one troy ounce of LBMA Good Delivery silver vaulted in Asia.
collateral: LBMA-accredited 99.9% Good Delivery silver bars held in Asian vaults under Matrixdock's fractional-reserve-safeguard framework
pegMechanism: Silver-backed commodity token redeemable through Matrixdock for KYC-approved users; issuer materials expose supply, bullion weight, and an oz-per-token metric that may drift slightly from exactly one ounce
